reader-1.source_observations:
Column 1 of PDF page 83 (printed page [82], heading CORPUS SORTED FROM THE END) holds 36 numbered rows between y 77 and y 774 pt at a pitch of about 19.75 pt, and no unnumbered continuation line. Each row is left-aligned: the inscription number sits above the five-position classification at x 316-339 pt, the drawings begin near x 347 pt, and a fish-like drawing comes first in every row. The packet's 36 page-83 items cover ordinals 1-36 once each; the three supplementary items come from page 76 (ordinal 36), page 107 (ordinal 21) and page 146 (ordinal 35), counted from the top of the right-hand column of each page. The page carries two text columns, and the left one (x below 285 pt) belongs to the other batch. Isolated specks lie in the right margin at x 584-590 pt beside some rows and belong to no drawing.

Reading conventions shared by the rows. Blank spaces inside a row follow the lines/sides digit of the classification: digit 6 comes with one gap of 16 pt or more, digit 7 with two, and digit 2 with one. Each group of plain strokes is one drawing. The chart cells for two and for three long strokes coincide (9 and 765, 10 and 766; underlined 543 and 769), so both codes are kept, while four plain strokes have only 767. The chart labels 465/485/486 (underlined six-bar comb) and 205/206/208 (U with hooks and two ticks) were resolved against the original sign list as 485 and 206. A pair of short ticks level with the top of the fish is code 25, and a pair at its vertical middle is code 2. A narrow hatched span that begins about 2 pt after the preceding drawing, at the same place where a wide span begins, is code 597; the shifted form 598 would leave a blank of about 9 pt before it. A hatched square with a scribble over it is recorded as a hatched span with code 596.

Exact boxes. All page-83 boxes share the left edge x 338.0 and the right edge x 572 and tile the column vertically. Underline dashes lie about 1.3 pt below the baseline of their row, so in many rows the box ends above its own dashes, and the dashes then appear at the top of the next row's box. From row 16 downward the page skew carries the last classification digit across x 338, and the boxes include a slice of it that widens from 0.2 pt in rows 16-22 to 1.0 pt in rows 32-36; a box was counted as incorrect when the slice holds 25 or more ink pixels at 5 px per pt. Rows 1, 2, 8, 11, 12, 15, 20 and 25 and the page-107 item have complete crops with no foreign ink.
